card.name: Words before a quantity or value
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or brackets right before a number, unit or measured value, such as after 'Females:' in creatinine clearance formulas or before 'g/cc' in element property lists. It also fires on 'on' or 'of' before 'body surface area'.

modes.label: Formula and property lists
modes.description: The space or opening bracket just before a value or unit in a formula or a table of element properties.

modes.label: Linking words in dose comparisons
modes.description: A small word leading into a basis of comparison or an inspection instruction in label text.
modes.example: based<< on>> body surface area (BSA) comparison

card.writes: It suppresses rating and measurement words, so it steers the next word away from them toward plain values or units.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number or unit is about to appear, as in formulas and dose comparisons.
